content: Written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi, the Hunter x Hunter manga began serialization in 1998 and remains one of the biggest series in Weekly Shonen Jump . Despite the continuing success of the series, which has been told for almost three decades, manga chapters have been released intermittently due to creator…

title: Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent Anime's Teaser Reveals Staff, 2027 TV Debut
content: The official website for the anime of Naruki 's Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent ( Megane, Tokidoki, Yankee-kun ) manga unveiled a new teaser promotional video and visuals for the anime on Tuesday. The teaser announces the main staff and the 2027 television premiere for the anime.
author: ANN

title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Season 2 Reveals Teaser Trailer, October 2026 Release Date
content: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World is returning this fall, with Season 2 officially set to begin in October 2026. A new teaser trailer has also been released ahead of the premiere. The sequel was announced in May 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Kidou Keisatsu Patlabor: EZY' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, File 3 Teaser Trailer
content: The official website for the Kidou Keisatsu Patlabor: EZY ( Patlabor The Mobile Police: EZY ) anime revealed an additional cast pair, File 3 key visual (pictured), and teaser trailer on Tuesday. The first installment opened in theaters on May 15, and the second installment is scheduled to premiere on August 14.
author: MyAnimeList

title: I'm Giving the Disgraced Noble Lady I Rescued a Crash Course in Naughtiness Manga Ends
content: Comic PASH! published the final chapter of Ichiho Katsura 's manga adaptation of Sametarō Fukada 's I'm Giving the Disgraced Noble Lady I Rescued a Crash Course in Naughtiness light novels last Thursday. Katsura drew an illustration to celebrate the conclusion.
author: ANN

title: One of Crunchyroll’s Highest-Rated Series Is Officially a Hit After Latest Update
content: The Summer 2026 anime season has already released all the new series, and the lineup is more exciting than ever. Just like every other season, Crunchyroll added dozens of upcoming series to its library and began streaming new episodes weekly after the Japanese broadcast.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Years Later, Acclaimed Shonen Jump Series Finally Returns With a New U.S. Release
content: D.Gray-man is considered one of the best Shonen Jump series of all time thanks to its captivating storytelling and exceptional cast of characters. Written and illustrated by Katsura Hoshino, the manga debuted in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2004 but transitioned to Shueisha’s Jump Square Rise in 2018.
author: ComicBook

title: Shinobi Undercover Manga Gets Novel
content: Shueisha is listing a novel for Ippon Takegushi and Santa Mitarashi 's Shinobi Undercover ( Shinobigoto ) manga titled Shinobigoto A Day in the Life Birds , with a slated release date of September 4. Kiyoko Hoshi is wiring the novel.
author: ANN

title: Magical Explorer Anime Reveals First Trailer, Key Visual, October 2026 Release
content: Magical Explorer: Reborn as a Side Character in a Fantasy Dating Sim anime revealed a key visual, trailer, as well as an October 2026 release date. Studio WHITE FOX is handling the animation, with Kazuki Ohashi as the director. The anime was first announced in September 2023.
author: Anime Corner
